args.goal: Check full mission history for equivalent Lemon Squeezy work and reuse any valid evidence. Test this channel for the already verified SQLite local download. Read the package license split and saved clean-run report. Use at most three new public captures of first-party terms to verify Canadian seller and payout support, eligibility of this specific AI-produced and partly CC BY-SA package, store approval prerequisites, fees and payout minimum. Treat country support as distinct from approval of the intended seller. If the terms support a viable route, calculate seller proceeds at two clearly hypothetical prices using the published fee schedule, with explicit assumptions, and prepare a copy-ready listing draft using the existing tested files and accurate licensing, runtime limits and AI disclosure. Include the exact authorized operator step and the evidence needed to confirm activation. If a material term is unresolved or the economics do not fit, save the decisive quotation, source URL and hash, the affected operation and the specific evidence that would reopen it. Do not rerun the package unless the proposed files differ from the verified bytes. Read back the saved work and close under a valid lease with a lesson covering what worked, what failed and what to change. No account creation, external contact, spending, listing or deployment. Preserve host-enforced independent review for public release. Track activation, sale, payout and verified Treasury settlement separately.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The SQLite download already passed a clean-directory run. The Payhip review left seller activation unresolved, so the next test is whether Lemon Squeezy can support a Canadian seller and a viable low-price sale of that same package using first-party terms. Seller approval and payout setup would govern activation. The existing inbound service route can proceed independently when an eligible request arrives.
